reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her thread in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

Tobias logged it in that same channel on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could already see this.

The ticket number is solid, but the link to Marrow Fieldworks is my inference. Tobias called it his "dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. The Jan 2 handoff digest calls Marrow Fieldworks Pree's dealer account and says it changed hands on 5 Jan 2026, but it doesn't say who took it over. My reply overstated this a little: it says the handoff notes show the dealer account is Marrow Fieldworks. I also suggested she check the latest status with Tobias before her call, which would confirm the match too.

There are no account files for Marrow under the shared files, so there was no ticket record to check against.
